review_status.human_review: Human-guided product and implementation review was performed through requirements, design feedback and iterative corrections. The latest 14 November 2026 changes passed GitHub Actions dependency installation, TypeScript validation and production build. This is not an independent line-by-line engineering audit or a visual browser QA.

review_status.note: A successful production build does not prove browser compatibility, complete human audit, error-free runtime behavior or scientific validity.

generated_media: No AI-generated photographs, images or videos are intentionally included.
scientific_data: The website must not present simulated or uncomputed values as validated measurements.
note: The 14 November 2026 landing-page refinement adds a 30-second interactive walkthrough, a clear three-step process, source-traceable reference-feature cards, science and data-source explanations, six definitions of scientific outputs and a project-transparency section. The public /explorer route now exposes the existing site/date scenario demonstrator. It does not calculate observer-specific ephemerides, local terrain horizons, power yield, RF link margins or landing suitability.
